title: Ross Coulthart gets Brent to name Harrington on camera

tellings.quote: 19 or 20 or something when Ross Coldart got me on camera and just pushed me so

plain: Brent Friedman, who speaks as a witness, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2019 or 2020 a man named Ross Coulthart got him on camera and kept pushing him. Friedman says this pressure led him to name a person called Harrington on camera, a name tied to the secret story he was telling.
